originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: MSS (1304.4132) proves bipartite Ramanujan families via 2-lift signings only, no 3-lifts or K7 cell; HPS (1506.02335) proves for every r an r-covering with new eigenvalues <=rho one-sided (real-rooted r-th matching polynomial in [-rho,rho] for the upper bound), so for non-bipartite K7 it gives only an upper bound and no two-sided |.| certificate, let alone the explicit 7974<8000 Ramanujan witness; Bordenave-Collins (1801.00876) is a large-n (n->infinity) strong-freeness / Alon-Boppana limit, not a fixed n=3 21-vertex certificate. No source tabulates the six exact expected rationals (0,126,210,2226,7770,59136), the order-5-exact KM match with excess 15, or this voltage list. Admission arXiv searches returned no hits for this cell; fetched abstracts confirm scope mismatch. Result is not a renamed implementation or parameter substitution of a general formula.

value.rationale: TARGET audit against admitted target: exists 3-lift of K7 within 2*sqrt5+0.5 with expansion witness. Report proves target and strengthens it to explicit Ramanujan (|new|<2*sqrt5) plus exact expected-moment invariant. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (minimal 6-regular Ramanujan base K7, minimal beyond-MSS degree 3, minimal tree-sensitive orders <=6), value not known or mechanically implied, and the precise facts (moment table, voltage list, 7974<8000 cert) are independently retrievable and reusable for codes/sparsifiers/expanders and other bases. Per value policy, a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object qualifies without a new general theorem; certification does not rescue an arbitrary object, but this object is non-arbitrary. Not a textbook restatement, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
